FCO.text: Rome is the capital of Italy and a city in layers, from the Colosseum and the Pantheon to the Vatican Library. The main sights run to about seventeen hours, so three or four days is a fair minimum. April and May are the best months.

CIA.text: Rome is the capital of Italy and a city in layers, from the Colosseum and the Pantheon to the Vatican Library. The main sights run to about seventeen hours, so three or four days is a fair minimum. April and May are the best months.

VCE.text: Venice is a city in Italy built across islands in a lagoon, with canals in place of streets. St Mark's Basilica, the Doge's Palace and the Rialto Bridge lead the sights, and ten hours covers them. May to July is the season.

TSF.text: Venice is a city in Italy built across islands in a lagoon, with canals in place of streets. St Mark's Basilica, the Doge's Palace and the Rialto Bridge lead the sights, and ten hours covers them. May to July is the season.

CDG.text: Paris is the capital of France and its main centre for art, food and fashion. The Eiffel Tower, the Louvre Museum and the Musee d'Orsay carry a first visit, and the main sights run to seventeen hours. May to September is the best stretch.

ORY.text: Paris is the capital of France and its main centre for art, food and fashion. The Eiffel Tower, the Louvre Museum and the Musee d'Orsay carry a first visit, and the main sights run to seventeen hours. May to September is the best stretch.

BVA.text: Paris is the capital of France and its main centre for art, food and fashion. The Eiffel Tower, the Louvre Museum and the Musee d'Orsay carry a first visit, and the main sights run to seventeen hours. May to September is the best stretch.

BCN.text: Barcelona is a port city on the Mediterranean coast of Spain and the capital of Catalonia. Sagrada Familia and Park Guell lead the sights, with city beaches close to the centre. April to June and September avoid the worst heat.

DBV.text: Dubrovnik is a walled town on the Adriatic coast of Croatia, compact enough to cross on foot. The Rector's Palace, Dubrovnik Cathedral and Lokrum lead the sights, and six hours covers them. May to August is the season.

gem:amalfi-coast.text: The Amalfi Coast is a run of cliffside villages in Campania, Italy, listed by UNESCO. Pompeii and Mount Vesuvius are the main sights within reach, and public transport along it is limited. May to August is the season.

gem:pompeii.text: Pompeii is a Roman town near Naples, buried by Mount Vesuvius in AD 79 and dug out since. The House of the Faun and the Amphitheatre of Pompeii are the set pieces, with Herculaneum nearby. Six hours is enough.

VIE.text: Vienna, the capital of Austria, grew up around the Habsburg court and is known for its musical life. Schonbrunn Palace, the Hofburg Palace and the Museum of Art History lead the sights. April to September is the best stretch.

SZG.text: Salzburg is a baroque city in Austria near the German border, and the birthplace of Mozart. Hohensalzburg Fortress looks down on the old town, with Salzburg Cathedral and Schloss Mirabell below. Ten hours covers the sights.

AMS.text: Amsterdam, the capital of the Netherlands, is laid out around a ring of canals. The Rijksmuseum and the Van Gogh Museum are the two that fill a day, with Vondelpark for the gap between them. June to August is the warmest stretch.

BGO.text: Bergen is a coastal city in Norway, the usual starting point for the western fjords. Bryggen and Bergenhus Fortress stand by the harbour, with Floyen and Ulriken rising behind. June to August is the season.

gem:bruges.text: Bruges is a medieval city in Flanders, Belgium, with its old centre largely intact. The Basilica of the Holy Blood, the Church of Our Lady and the Groeningemuseum are the sights that matter. June to August is busiest.

gem:tuscany-siena.text: Siena is a city in Tuscany, Italy, at the head of the Val d'Orcia wine country. Siena Cathedral, piazza del Campo and the Palazzo Pubblico lead the sights, and public transport is poor. May, June and September are the best months.

FLR.text: Florence is the capital of Tuscany and the city where the Italian Renaissance began. Santa Maria del Fiore, the Galleria degli Uffizi and the Ponte Vecchio are the fixed points. April to June and September are the best months.

LIS.text: Lisbon is the capital of Portugal, set on hills where the Tagus meets the Atlantic. Belem Tower, the Jeronimos Monastery and the Alfama district carry most of a visit. June to September is the warm season.

OPO.text: Porto is the second city of Portugal, stacked above the Douro estuary and known for its wine. The Dom Luis I Bridge, Porto Cathedral and the Palacio da Bolsa lead the sights, and ten hours covers them. June to August is the warm season.

EDI.text: Edinburgh is the Scottish capital, built on volcanic rock between a castle and a palace. Edinburgh Castle, the Palace of Holyroodhouse and St Giles' Cathedral anchor the old town, with Arthur's Seat rising above it. June to August is the season.

gem:como.text: Lake Como is a long alpine lake in Lombardy, Italy, ringed by villages and old villas. Bellagio and Varenna face each other across the water, and Villa Carlotta is the garden to see. Public transport is poor, so a boat helps.

gem:kotor.text: Kotor is a walled coastal town in Montenegro, set at the head of the Bay of Kotor. The Fortifications of Kotor climb the slope behind the old town, and Lovcen stands above. May and June are the best months.

SPU.text: Split is a coastal city in Dalmatia, Croatia, where the old town grew inside a Roman palace. Diocletian's Palace and the Cathedral of Saint Domnius are the core, with Klis Fortress inland. Ten hours covers the sights.

gem:cinque-terre.text: Cinque Terre is a line of five coastal villages in Liguria, Italy, with terraced slopes behind them. Cinque Terre National Park covers the ground they stand on, and the islands of Palmaria and Tino lie off the point. June to August is the season.

gem:granada.text: Granada is a city in Andalucia, Spain, below the Sierra Nevada. The Alhambra and the Generalife gardens take up most of a visit, with the Albaicin quarter on the hill opposite. May, June and September are the best months.

gem:syracuse.text: Syracuse is a coastal city in Italy with a baroque old town and ancient ruins. Ortigia holds the Cathedral of Syracuse and Castello Maniace, with the Ear of Dionysius inland. April and May are the best months.

NAP.text: Naples is a port city on the Mediterranean coast of Italy, dense and layered, with Mount Vesuvius close by. Castel dell'Ovo, Castel Nuovo and the Teatro di San Carlo lead the sights. May is the best month.

PRG.text: Prague is the largest city in Czechia and the old seat of Bohemia, laid out along the Vltava. Prague Castle, Saint Vitus Cathedral and Charles Bridge form one walk across the river. May to September is the best stretch.

gem:hallstatt.text: Hallstatt is a lakeside village in Austria, wedged between the Hallstatter See and the slopes behind it. The Dachstein Mountains and Krippenstein are the reason to stay past the viewpoint. May to September is the best stretch.

gem:matera.text: Matera is a city in Basilicata, Italy, with a quarter cut into the rock. The Sassi di Matera are the reason to come, and Matera Cathedral stands above them. May and June are the best months.

gem:meteora.text: Meteora is a cluster of rock pillars in Greece with monasteries built on top of them. The Monastery of the Holy Trinity and Varlaam monastery are the two most visited, and three hours covers a circuit. April and May are the best months.

gem:taormina.text: Taormina is a hillside town above the sea in Sicily, Italy. The Ancient theatre of Taormina looks out over the water, and Isola Bella lies on the shore below. May and June are the best months.

gem:agrigento-valle-dei-templi.text: Agrigento is a coastal town in Italy above a line of ancient temples. The Valle dei Templi holds the Temple of Concordia, the best preserved of them, and six hours covers the site. April and May are the best months.

CFU.text: Corfu is a Greek island in the Adriatic, off the northwest coast of the country. Beaches such as Agios Gordios and Myrtiotissa ring the island, and Butrint is within reach. May and June are the best months.

VRN.text: Verona is a city in the Veneto, Italy, with a Roman core and a reputation from Shakespeare. The Verona Arena is the largest thing in the centre, with the Museo di Castelvecchio and Porta Borsari nearby. April to June and September suit best.

JTR.text: Santorini is a volcanic island group in the Cyclades, Greece, arranged around a caldera. Akrotiri preserves a settlement buried by the eruption, and Nea Kameni sits in the middle of the bay. May to September is the season.

STN.text: London is the largest city in the United Kingdom, spread along the Thames in the south of England. The Tower of London, Westminster Abbey and the British Museum lead a long list, and the main sights run to seventeen hours. June to September is best.

LTN.text: London is the largest city in the United Kingdom, spread along the Thames in the south of England. The Tower of London, Westminster Abbey and the British Museum lead a long list, and the main sights run to seventeen hours. June to September is best.

LGW.text: London is the largest city in the United Kingdom, spread along the Thames in the south of England. The Tower of London, Westminster Abbey and the British Museum lead a long list, and the main sights run to seventeen hours. June to September is best.

LHR.text: London is the largest city in the United Kingdom, spread along the Thames in the south of England. The Tower of London, Westminster Abbey and the British Museum lead a long list, and the main sights run to seventeen hours. June to September is best.

KRK.text: Krakow is a city in southern Poland and was its capital in the Middle Ages. Wawel sits above the river, with the Krakow Old Town and Kazimierz below. May to September is the best stretch.

gem:lauterbrunnen.text: Lauterbrunnen is a village in a steep valley in the Bernese Oberland, Switzerland, with waterfalls down both walls. The Jungfrau, the Eiger and the Monch rise at the head of it, and Trummelbach is the waterfall to see. June to August is the season.

gem:dolomites.text: The Dolomites are a mountain range in Italy, walked in summer and skied in winter. Tre Cime di Lavaredo is the best known group, and Cortina d'Ampezzo is the main base. Public transport is poor.

gem:toledo.text: Toledo is a walled city in Castilla La Mancha, Spain, on a bend of the Tagus. Toledo Cathedral, the Alcazar of Toledo and the Synagogue of Santa Maria la Blanca sit within a few streets of each other. April and May are the best months.

gem:bath.text: Bath is a spa city in the United Kingdom, built in pale Georgian stone over Roman baths. Bath Abbey, the Royal Crescent and Pulteney Bridge are the set pieces, and ten hours covers them. June to September is the season.

gem:portovenere.text: Portovenere is a coastal village in Italy, listed by UNESCO along with the islands off it. Isola Palmaria, Tino and Isola del Tinetto lie offshore. May to July is the season, and public transport is poor.

gem:mount-etna.text: Mount Etna is an active volcano in Sicily, Italy, with a national park around it. The Grotta del Gelo and Acireale Cathedral are the sights nearby, and five hours covers a visit. June to August is the season.
